verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਕਲ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਆਪਨੀ ਆਪਨੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਚੰਦਨ ਕਰੈ ਸਰਬ ਤਮਾਲ ਕਉ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau sakal dhrum aapanee aapanee bhaa(n)t cha(n)dhan cha(n)dhan karai sarab tamaal kau||

en.bdb: Just as all trees grow and spread according to the nature of their species and they cannot impose their influence on others but a sandalwood tree can make all other trees smell like itself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾਂਬਾ ਹੀ ਸੈ ਹੋਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਕੰਚਨ ਕਲੰਕੁ ਡਾਰੈ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਸਕਲ ਉਜਾਲ ਕਉ ॥
verses.translit_en: taa(n)baa hee sai hot jaise ka(n)chan kala(n)k ddaarai paaras paras dhaat sakal ujaal kau ||

en.bdb: Just as addition of some special chemical in copper. can convert it into gold, but all metals can become gold by the touch of a philosopher-stone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਿਤਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਗਤਿ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਸੰਗਮ ਸਮ ਜਲ ਸੁਢਾਲ ਕਉ॥
verses.translit_en: saritaa anek jaise bibidh pravaeh gat surasaree sa(n)gam sam jal suddaal kau||

en.bdb: Just as the flow of many rivers is different in many ways, but their water becomes pure and sacred once they mingle with water of river Ganges.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਸਕਲ ਦੇਵ ਟੇਵ ਸੈ ਟਰਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਲ ਕਉ ॥੪੫੯॥
verses.translit_en: taise hee sakal dhev Tev sai Tarat naeh satigur asaran saran akaal kau ||459||

en.bdb: Similarly, none of the gods and goddesses change their basic character. (They can reward someone according to their nature). But like sandalwood, philosopher-stone and river Ganges, the True Guru takes all under his refuge and blessing them with Naam Amrit, he unites them all with the Lord.  (459)
